Adverse Effects and Precautions Immediate post-injection reactions are common with glatiramer acetate and include chest pain, palpitations or tachycardia, dysp- noea, throat constriction, urticaria, flushing (vasodilatation), and anxiety. These reactions are generally short-lived and resolve spontaneously. They have generally occurred only some months after treatment with glatiramer was started.
